```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("tictoc", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'tictoc' is required but not installed.")
}
#devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ej91016/SSM/main/R/ssm.R")
#devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ej91016/SSM/main/R/ssm_plot.R")
source('ssm.R')
source("ssm_plot.R")
```

```{r}
#a template for executing distcal
tictoc::tic('total')

homedir=file.path(getwd(),'demo') #adjust as needed
print(homedir)
if (!dir.exists(homedir)) {
  dir.create(homedir, recursive = TRUE)
}
#includes unweighted and ssa weighted parsimony if parsimony=TRUE
resultframe=getresult(parsimony=TRUE)
detailframe=getresult(parsimony=TRUE)
tnum=10
snum=10
rth=2
parallel=2

for (i in 1:10){ #loop through different values of a parameter
    mydata=distcal(state_num=c(2,7),char_num=c(500,500),rate=i/10,
                     ntip=8,birth=1,death=0,tree_num=tnum,set_num=snum,
                     mainDir=homedir,rthreads=rth,par=parallel,parsimony = T,
                   fixtree=NULL
    )
    update=distcal_summary(dm=mydata$distance,
                           index=i,
                           filename=mydata$fname,
                           result=resultframe,
                           detail=detailframe,
                           xaxis=i/10) #this is the i variable in result file
    resultframe=update$result
    detailframe=update$detail
    print(paste0("i=",i,' is completed'))
}

mysetup='demo_ssaw.csv' #desired output name

write.csv(resultframe,file.path(homedir,mysetup))
write.csv(detailframe,file.path(homedir,paste0('detail_',mysetup)))
print(paste0(mysetup,' is done.'))
tictoc::toc()

```

```{r,fig.width=6}
#this summarize result files if analysis is interrupted
mypath="directory_that_contain_the_set_of_run"
mysummary= run_summary(parsimony=TRUE,path=mypath)
write.csv(mysummary$result,paste0(mypath,'testresults_temp.csv'))
write.csv(mysummary$detail,paste0(mypath,'detail_testresults_temp.csv'))
```
